question: What are the names of countries that speak more than 8 languages, as well as how many languages they speak?
gold_query: SELECT COUNT(T2.Language) , T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode GROUP BY T1.Name HAVING COUNT(*) > 8
